SKEPTIC should focus on adversarial spec boundaries: null propagation, invalid operand types, Integer/Long/Decimal precision and overflow boundaries, Quantity arithmetic and unit compatibility, divide-by-zero behavior, high/low boundary precision, logarithm/domain errors, direct public DuckDB helper calls, native-loaded versus forced Python fallback parity, and generated SQL execution in scalar and population-style contexts.

Start from scratch for this chunk/personality and do not inspect or rely on any archived prior workflow outputs under .ai_loop/spec_comp/**, including CQL-10 artifacts if present and any older consolidated-run artifacts. When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.title: Dynamic FHIR value[x] arithmetic used text coercion
issues.spec_area: CQL Arithmetic Operators Part 1 - Add and Divide
evidence: Observation.value + 1 translated through fhirpath_text and string concatenation, so valueInteger 5 produced '51'.
Observation.value / 2 translated through fhirpath_text plus TRY_CAST, so valueString '5' produced 2.5.
Observation.value / 2 over valueQuantity 10 mg returned scalar 5.0, losing Quantity unit semantics.
issues.root_cause: The '+' string concatenation path treated any fhirpath_text operand as String before numeric arithmetic dispatch, and generic arithmetic casts used fhirpath_text/TRY_CAST for dynamic FHIR choice values instead of typed fhirpath_number for numeric value[x] extraction.
issues.resolution: Numeric '+' now bypasses string concatenation when either operand is numerically typed, and arithmetic casting uses the existing fhirpath_number projection for FHIR value/value.* paths before falling back to text or Quantity JSON handling.

issues.title: Unsupported Quantity plus scalar lowered to date arithmetic
evidence: 10 'mg' + 2 lowered to dateAddQuantity(2, <quantity json>) and raised a DuckDB binder error instead of producing NULL for an unsupported arithmetic overload.
The first remediation pass over-rejected temporal Quantity arithmetic and was caught by official CQL conformance cases using Today() and aggregate interval expressions.
issues.root_cause: The Quantity +/- dispatch treated any Quantity plus non-Quantity as date/time arithmetic by swapping operands into dateAddQuantity without first proving the peer was temporal.
issues.resolution: Quantity +/- now returns NULL for definitely non-temporal scalar peers while preserving date/time plus time-valued Quantity for temporal or unknown aggregate/query expressions. FunctionRef temporal detection includes Today, Now, and TimeOfDay for date/time arithmetic, and TimeOfDay comparison avoids the DateTime UDF route that cannot parse DuckDB CURRENT_TIME timezone text.
